notes: Resistor value is not stated in the manual (it points to an external LED calculation page); 220 ohm is assumed.

Wiring follows the Fritzing diagram: resistor from column 1 to column 5, LED long leg (anode) in column 5 and short leg (cathode) in column 6, all in rows a-e (bank 't'). The exact rows used for the LED legs and resistor ends are approximated within each column strip, since they are electrically equivalent.
Red jumper goes from breadboard 1a to GPIO17 (physical pin 11). Black jumper goes from breadboard 6a to a GND pin (physical pin 20, GND.4, in the diagram).
The photo shows the same LED and resistor placed on a breadboard. The solder and jumper-only variants and the 3.3V direct test (led3.png) are alternatives and are not modelled.
The long LED leg connects towards the GPIO pin via the resistor, and the short leg goes to ground, as the manual states.
